typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	totblCalypsoMarkitWireExceptionsLegType_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		TRADE_ID as decimal(38,0),
		PRODUCT_FAMILY as string,
		PRODUCT_TYPE as string,
		PRODUCT_SUB_TYPE as string,
		PRODUCT_ID as decimal(38,0),
		FIXEDLEG as string,
		FLOATLEG as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> fromcalypsodbaswapleg
fromcalypsodbaswapleg derive({Copy of PRODUCT_FAMILY} = PRODUCT_FAMILY,
		{Copy of TRADE_ID} = toString(TRADE_ID),
		{Copy of PRODUCT_SUB_TYPE} = PRODUCT_SUB_TYPE,
		{Copy of PRODUCT_ID} = toString(PRODUCT_ID),
		{Copy of FLOATLEG} = FLOATLEG,
		{Copy of FIXEDLEG} = FIXEDLEG,
		{Copy of PRODUCT_TYPE} = PRODUCT_TYPE) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		product_sub_type as string,
		product_family as string,
		product_type as string,
		trade_id as string,
		product_id as string,
		FloatLeg as string,
		FixedLeg as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		product_sub_type = {Copy of PRODUCT_SUB_TYPE},
		product_family = {Copy of PRODUCT_FAMILY},
		product_type = {Copy of PRODUCT_TYPE},
		trade_id = {Copy of TRADE_ID},
		product_id = {Copy of PRODUCT_ID},
		FloatLeg = {Copy of FLOATLEG},
		FixedLeg = {Copy of FIXEDLEG}),
	partitionFileNames:[($totblCalypsoMarkitWireExceptionsLegType_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> totblCalypsoMarkitWireExceptionsLegType
